text:
Iris Cho: heads-up: sample-app errors in staging when using JSON mode + streaming fncalls. seems to be after the new stream path rolled out.
Marco Diaz: paste an example? probably partial JSON chunks causing JSON.parse to fail.
Iris Cho: yep. snippet: 
[data] '{\"call\":{\"name\":\"upsert\",\"args\":{\"docs\":[\"a\",'
[data] '"b"]}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of input
Sofie Lind: SDK currently validates each data event eagerly. for streams we need to assemble top-level JSON first.
Avi Banerjee: options: server-side framing (bigger change) or SDK helper collector (fast DX fix). I vote helper.
Iris Cho: agreed. requirements: balanced-brace detection, safe memory cap, time cap, partial marker so apps can opt into incremental handling.
Marco Diaz: prototype API (TS):
for await (const ev of client.stream(...)) {
  const frame = await collectTopJson(ev, {maxBytes: 128*1024, maxWaitMs: 200})
  if (frame.partial) handlePartial(frame.payload) else validateSchema(JSON.parse(frame.payload))
}
Sofie Lind: ensure token-forwarding mode where app still gets tokens ASAP while collector assembles the full object for validation.
Avi Banerjee: parity: implement identical semantics in python (async generator) and node. tests should include escaped braces inside strings and NDJSON tool outputs.
Iris Cho: also add telemetry tags: jsonframe_mode, jsonframe_bytes, jsonframe_latency_ms. helps tune defaults.
Sofie Lind: infra note: avoid double-validation during retries; add idempotency guard in validator pipeline.
devex-bot: opened issue #8720 "streaming-json SDK collector + parity + telemetry" assigned Iris/Marco/Sofie.
Iris Cho: will open draft PR behind feature flag with tests and sample-app doc snippet. Marco will mirror py impl after TS lands.
Marco Diaz: I'll take python follow-up and add integration test to sample-app harness.
Avi Banerjee: sounds good. checklist: unit tests, node+py parity, sample-app doc, telemetry, feature flag.
Sofie Lind: LGTM. :+1:
Iris Cho: thanks everyone, will ping when PR is ready for review.
